translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent envoys to welcome and reward him. The edict said, "I hear you have taken the Southern Capital and pacified troops and people. Very good.

sentences.zh: 諸軍之賞，卿差等以給之。」

translations.literal: Rewards for the armies are to be given in graded measure by you."
translations.idiomatic: Rewards for the armies are to be given in graded measure by you."

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「南京疆場如舊，屯兵以鎮之。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "The Southern Capital's borders remain as before; station troops to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said, "The Southern Capital's borders remain as before. Station troops to garrison them.

sentences.zh: 命有司運米五萬石于廣甯，給南京、潤州戍卒。」

translations.literal: The responsible offices were ordered to transport fifty thousand shi of grain to Guangning to supply the garrison troops of the Southern Capital and Runzhou."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were ordered to transport fifty thousand shi of grain to Guangning to supply the garrison troops of the Southern Capital and Runzhou."

sentences.zh: 遂下宜州，拔叉牙山，殺其節度使韓慶民，得糧五千石。

translations.literal: Yizhou was then taken, Chaya Mountain was stormed, its military commissioner Han Qingmin was killed, and five thousand shi of grain were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou was then taken, Chaya Mountain was stormed, its military commissioner Han Qingmin was killed, and five thousand shi of grain were obtained.

sentences.zh: 詔以南路歲饑，許田獵。

translations.literal: An edict permitted hunting because the southern route suffered famine that year.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted hunting because the southern route suffered famine that year.

sentences.zh: 其後宋童貫、郭藥師治兵，闍母輒因降人知之，即具奏，語在宋事中。

translations.literal: Later, when the Song's Tong Guan and Guo Yaoshi trained troops, She Mu always learned of it through surrendered men and memorialized at once — the account is in the Song annals.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the Song's Tong Guan and Guo Yaoshi trained troops, She Mu always learned of it through surrendered men and memorialized at once — the account is in the Song annals.

sentences.zh: 而宗翰、宗望皆請伐宋，於是闍母副宗望伐宋，宗望以闍母屬尊，先皇帝任使有功，請以為都統，己監戰事。

translations.literal: Zonghan and Zongwang both requested a campaign against Song; She Mu then served as deputy to Zongwang in attacking Song. Zongwang, because She Mu was senior and the former emperor had employed him with merit, requested that he be made commander-in-chief while he himself supervised the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan and Zongwang both requested a campaign against Song. She Mu then served as deputy to Zongwang in attacking Song. Zongwang, because She Mu was senior and the former emperor had employed him with merit, requested that he be made commander-in-chief while he himself supervised the fighting.

sentences.zh: 於是闍母為都統，掃喝副之，敗郭藥師兵于白河，遂降燕山，以先鋒渡河圍汴，宋人請盟。

translations.literal: She Mu was therefore made commander-in-chief with Saohuo as his deputy; they defeated Guo Yaoshi's army at the Bai River, then reduced the Yan Mountains, and as vanguard crossed the river to besiege Bian; the Song requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: She Mu was therefore made commander-in-chief with Saohuo as his deputy. They defeated Guo Yaoshi's army at the Bai River, reduced the Yan Mountains, and as vanguard crossed the river to besiege Bian. The Song requested peace.

sentences.zh: 將士分屯于安肅、雄、霸、廣、信之境，宗望還山西，闍母與劉彥宗留燕京，節制諸軍。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers were distributed to garrison Ansu, Xiong, Ba, Guang, and Xin; Zongwang returned to Shanxi, and She Mu with Liu Yanzong remained at Yanjing to command the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers were distributed to garrison Ansu, Xiong, Ba, Guang, and Xin. Zongwang returned to Shanxi, and She Mu with Liu Yanzong remained at Yanjing to command the armies.

sentences.zh: 八月，複伐宋，大軍克汴州，諸軍屯於城上。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they again attacked Song; the great army took Bianzhou and the armies encamped on the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they again attacked Song. The great army took Bianzhou and the armies encamped on the city walls.

sentences.zh: 城中諸軍潰而西出者十三萬人，闍母、撻懶分擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: More than a hundred thirty thousand men of the armies in the city broke out westward; She Mu and Talan struck separately and utterly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred thirty thousand men of the armies in the city broke out westward. She Mu and Talan struck separately and utterly defeated them.

sentences.zh: 師還，闍母為元帥左都監，攻河間，下之，大破敵兵萬余于莫州。

translations.literal: When the army returned, She Mu became left marshal supervisor; he attacked Hejian and took it, and at Mozhou utterly defeated more than ten thousand enemy troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, She Mu became left marshal supervisor. He attacked Hejian and took it, and at Mozhou utterly defeated more than ten thousand enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 宗輔為右副元帥，徇地淄、青。

translations.literal: Zongfu was right deputy marshal and pacified Zi and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Zongfu was right deputy marshal and pacified Zi and Qing.

sentences.zh: 闍母與宗弼分兵破山谷諸屯。

translations.literal: She Mu and Zongbi divided their forces to break the stockades in the valleys and mountains.
translations.idiomatic: She Mu and Zongbi divided their forces to break the stockades in the valleys and mountains.

sentences.zh: 宋李成兵圍淄州，烏林荅泰欲破之。

translations.literal: The Song's Li Cheng besieged Zizhou; Wulindda Tai wished to break them.
translations.idiomatic: The Song's Li Cheng besieged Zizhou. Wulindda Tai wished to break them.

sentences.zh: 闍母克濰州。

translations.literal: She Mu took Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: She Mu took Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 迪古補、術烈速連破趙子昉等兵，至於河上。

translations.literal: Digubu and Shilie Sulian repeatedly defeated Zhao Zifang and others and reached the river.
translations.idiomatic: Digubu and Shilie Sulian repeatedly defeated Zhao Zifang and others and reached the river.

sentences.zh: 烏林荅泰欲破敵於靈城鎮。

translations.literal: Wulindda Tai wished to break the enemy at Lingcheng Town.
translations.idiomatic: Wulindda Tai wished to break the enemy at Lingcheng Town.

sentences.zh: 及儀伐康王，闍母欲先定河北，然後進討，太宗乃酌取群議之中，使婁室取陝西，宗翰、宗輔南伐。

translations.literal: When they campaigned against the Prince of Kang, She Mu wished first to secure Hebei and then advance; the Taizong took the middle course among the various proposals, had Woshi take Shaanxi, and Zonghan and Zongfu march south.
translations.idiomatic: When they campaigned against the Prince of Kang, She Mu wished first to secure Hebei and then advance. The Taizong took the middle course among the various proposals, had Woshi take Shaanxi, and Zonghan and Zongfu march south.

sentences.zh: 天會七年，薨，年四十。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianhui he died, aged forty.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianhui he died, aged forty.

sentences.zh: 熙宗時，追封吳國王。

translations.literal: During Xizong's reign he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: During Xizong's reign he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 天德二年，配享太祖廟廷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiande he was given a place in the Taizu temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiande he was given a place in the Taizu temple hall.

sentences.zh: 正隆，改封譚王。

translations.literal: During Zhenglong his title was changed to Prince of Tan.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenglong his title was changed to Prince of Tan.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，徙封魯王，諡莊襄。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he was transferred to Prince of Lu and given the posthumous title Zhuangxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading he was transferred to Prince of Lu and given the posthumous title Zhuangxiang.

sentences.zh: 子宗敘。

translations.literal: His son Zongxu.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongxu.

sentences.zh: 宗敘，本名德壽，闍母第四子也。

translations.literal: Zongxu, original name Deshou, was She Mu's fourth son.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxu, originally named Deshou, was She Mu's fourth son.

sentences.zh: 奇偉有大志，喜談兵。

translations.literal: He was extraordinary in stature and had great ambition, delighting in discussing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was extraordinary in stature and had great ambition, delighting in discussing military affairs.

sentences.zh: 天德二年，充護衛，授武義將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiande he served as a guardsman and was appointed General of Martial Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiande he served as a guardsman and was appointed General of Martial Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 明年，授世襲謀克，擢禦院通進，遷翰林待制，兼修起居注，轉國子司業，兼左補闕。

translations.literal: The next year he was granted an hereditary company command, promoted to Imperial Household courier, moved to Hanlin attendant, also kept the diary of attendance, transferred to vice director of the Directorate of Education, and also served as left remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was granted an hereditary company command, promoted to Imperial Household courier, moved to Hanlin attendant, also kept the diary of attendance, transferred to vice director of the Directorate of Education, and also served as left remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 正隆初，轉符寶郎，在宮職凡五年，皆帶劍押領宿衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenlong he transferred to insignia keeper; in palace service for five years in all, he always carried a sword and led the night guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenlong he transferred to insignia keeper. In palace service for five years in all, he always carried a sword and led the night guard.

sentences.zh: 遷大宗正丞，以母憂去官。

translations.literal: He was moved to vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and left office on his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and left office on his mother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 以本官起複，未幾，遷侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使，改左驍騎都指揮使。

translations.literal: He resumed his former office before the mourning period ended; before long he was made commander of the personal guard cavalry and changed to commander of the left valiant cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He resumed his former office before the mourning period ended. Before long he was made commander of the personal guard cavalry and changed to commander of the left valiant cavalry.

sentences.zh: 明年，海陵幸南京，宗敘至汴。

translations.literal: The next year, when Hailing visited the Southern Capital, Zongxu reached Bian.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, when Hailing visited the Southern Capital, Zongxu reached Bian.

sentences.zh: 契丹撒八反，宗敘為咸平尹，兼本路兵馬都總管，以甲仗四千付之，許以便宜。

translations.literal: The Khitan Saba rebelled; Zongxu was made prefect of Xianping and also commander-in-chief of military affairs on this route; four thousand suits of armor were given him with authority to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan Saba rebelled. Zongxu was made prefect of Xianping and also commander-in-chief of military affairs on this route. Four thousand suits of armor were given him with authority to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 宗敘出松亭關，取牛遞于廣寧。

translations.literal: Zongxu left Songting Pass and obtained relay oxen at Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxu left Songting Pass and obtained relay oxen at Guangning.

sentences.zh: 聞世宗即位，將歸之。

translations.literal: Hearing that Shizong had taken the throne, he prepared to return to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Shizong had taken the throne, he prepared to return and submit.

sentences.zh: 廣甯尹按荅海弟燕京勸宗敘，乃還興中。

translations.literal: Guangning prefect An Dahai's younger brother Yanjing persuaded Zongxu, and he then returned to Xingzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Guangning prefect An Dahai's younger brother Yanjing persuaded Zongxu, and he then returned to Xingzhong.

sentences.zh: 白彥敬、紇石烈志甯使宗敘奉表降。

translations.literal: Bai Yanjing and Heshilie Zhining had Zongxu present a memorial of submission.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanjing and Heshilie Zhining had Zongxu present a memorial of submission.

sentences.zh: 宗敘見世宗于梁魚務，授甯昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: Zongxu met Shizong at Liangyuwu and was appointed military commissioner of Ningchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxu met Shizong at Liangyuwu and was appointed military commissioner of Ningchang.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，契丹攻甯昌，宗敘止有女直、渤海騎兵三十、漢兵百二十人，自將擊之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the next year the Khitan attacked Ningchang. Zongxu had only thirty Jurchen and Bohai horsemen and a hundred twenty Han soldiers; he led them out himself to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the next year the Khitan attacked Ningchang. Zongxu had only thirty Jurchen and Bohai horsemen and a hundred twenty Han soldiers. He led them out himself to attack.

sentences.zh: 遇賊千餘騎，漢兵皆散走，宗敘與女直、渤海三十騎盡銳力戰，身被二創，所乘馬中箭而僕，遂為所執。

translations.literal: They met more than a thousand enemy horsemen; the Han soldiers all scattered and fled. Zongxu with the thirty Jurchen and Bohai horsemen fought with all their strength; he received two wounds, his mount was struck by an arrow and fell, and he was seized.
translations.idiomatic: They met more than a thousand enemy horsemen. The Han soldiers all scattered and fled. Zongxu with the thirty Jurchen and Bohai horsemen fought with all their strength. He received two wounds, his mount was struck by an arrow and fell, and he was seized.

sentences.zh: 居百餘日，會賊中有臨潢民移刺阿塔等，盜馬授之，得脫歸。

translations.literal: After more than a hundred days, among the rebels were Linhuang men Yila Ata and others who stole a horse and gave it to him; he escaped and returned.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a hundred days, among the rebels were Linhuang men Yila Ata and others who stole a horse and gave it to him. He escaped and returned.

sentences.zh: 宗敘陷賊久，盡得其虛實，見元帥完顏謀衍、平章政事完顏元宜，謂之曰：「賊眾烏合，無紀律，破之易耳。」

translations.literal: Zongxu had long been among the rebels and learned all their true circumstances. Seeing Marshal Wanyan Moyan and Grand Councilor Wanyan Yuanyi, he said to them: "The rebel host is a mob gathered without discipline — they are easy to break."
translations.idiomatic: Zongxu had long been among the rebels and learned all their true circumstances. Seeing Marshal Wanyan Moyan and Grand Councilor Wanyan Yuanyi, he said to them, "The rebel host is a mob gathered without discipline — they are easy to break."

sentences.zh: 於是帥府欲授軍職，宗敘見謀衍貪鹵掠，失事機，欲歸白上，不肯受職，曰：「我有機密，須面奏。」

translations.literal: The command headquarters wished to grant him a military post, but Zongxu saw Moyan greedy for plunder and missing opportunities; wishing to return and report to the emperor, he refused the post, saying: "I have secrets that must be reported face to face."
translations.idiomatic: The command headquarters wished to grant him a military post, but Zongxu saw Moyan greedy for plunder and missing opportunities. Wishing to return and report to the emperor, he refused the post, saying, "I have secrets that must be reported face to face."

sentences.zh: 是夕，乃遁去，至廣寧，矯取驛馬，馳至京師。

translations.literal: That night he fled, reached Guangning, took relay horses by false authority, and galloped to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That night he fled, reached Guangning, took relay horses by false authority, and galloped to the capital.

sentences.zh: 而帥府先事以聞，上遣中使詰之曰：「汝為節度，不度眾寡，戰敗被獲，幸得脫歸，乃拒帥府命，輒自乘傳赴都，朕姑置汝罪，可速還軍，並力破賊。」

translations.literal: The command headquarters had already reported the matter first. The emperor sent a palace envoy to question him, saying: "You were a military commissioner yet did not measure strength against weakness; defeated and captured, you were fortunate to escape. Yet you refused the command's orders and rashly took relay horses to the capital. I will for the moment set aside your crime — return quickly to the army and join forces to break the rebels."
translations.idiomatic: The command headquarters had already reported the matter first. The emperor sent a palace envoy to question him, saying, "You were a military commissioner yet did not measure strength against weakness. Defeated and captured, you were fortunate to escape. Yet you refused the command's orders and rashly took relay horses to the capital. I will for the moment set aside your crime — return quickly to the army and join forces to break the rebels."

sentences.zh: 宗敘附奏曰：「臣非辭難者，事須面奏，不得不來。」

translations.literal: Zongxu appended a memorial saying: "Your servant is not one who shirks difficulty; the matter must be reported face to face and could not be otherwise."
translations.idiomatic: Zongxu appended a memorial saying, "Your servant is not one who shirks difficulty. The matter must be reported face to face and could not be otherwise."

sentences.zh: 遂召入，乃條奏賊中虛實，及諸軍進退不合事機狀。

translations.literal: He was then summoned in and set forth in detail the rebels' true circumstances and how the various armies' advances and retreats did not fit the opportunities.
translations.idiomatic: He was then summoned in and set forth in detail the rebels' true circumstances and how the various armies' advances and retreats did not fit the opportunities.

sentences.zh: 詔大臣議，皆以其言為然。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the great ministers to discuss it; all held his words correct.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the great ministers to discuss it. All held his words correct.

sentences.zh: 是時，已詔僕散忠義代謀衍為元帥進討，於是拜宗敘為兵部尚書，以本職領右翼都統，率宗甯、烏延查刺、烏林荅刺撒兵各千人，號三萬，佐忠義軍。

translations.literal: At that time an edict had already ordered Pusan Zhongyi to replace Moyan as marshal and advance to suppress them. Zongxu was then made Minister of War, and in his former office led the right-wing commander-in-chief, commanding a thousand men each from Zongning, Wuyan Zhaci, and Wulindda Cisa — called thirty thousand — to assist Zhongyi's army.
translations.idiomatic: At that time an edict had already ordered Pusan Zhongyi to replace Moyan as marshal and advance to suppress them. Zongxu was then made Minister of War and, in his former office, led the right-wing commander-in-chief, commanding a thousand men each from Zongning, Wuyan Zhaci, and Wulindda Cisa — called thirty thousand — to assist Zhongyi's army.

sentences.zh: 至花道，遇賊，與戰，左翼都統宗亨先敗走，忠義亦引卻，宗敘勒本部遮擊之，麾帳下士三百，舍馬步戰，賊不得逞。

translations.literal: At Huadao they met the rebels and fought. The left-wing commander-in-chief Zong Heng was first defeated and fled; Zhongyi also drew back. Zongxu led his command to intercept them, directing three hundred men of his personal guard to dismount and fight on foot; the rebels could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: At Huadao they met the rebels and fought. The left-wing commander-in-chief Zong Heng was first defeated and fled. Zhongyi also drew back. Zongxu led his command to intercept them, directing three hundred men of his personal guard to dismount and fight on foot. The rebels could not prevail.

sentences.zh: 大軍整列複至，合勢擊之，賊遂敗去。

translations.literal: The great army re-formed and came up again; joining forces they struck, and the rebels then fled away.
translations.idiomatic: The great army re-formed and came up again. Joining forces they struck, and the rebels fled away.

sentences.zh: 而元帥右監軍紇石烈志寧率軍至，追及窩斡於陷泉，大破之。

translations.literal: The marshal's right supervisor Heshilie Zhining led his army up; overtaking Wowo at Xianquan, he utterly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The marshal's right supervisor Heshilie Zhining led his army up, overtook Wowo at Xianquan, and utterly defeated them.

sentences.zh: 複與志甯及徒單克寧，追至七渡河，複大敗之。

translations.literal: Again with Zhining and Tushan Kening he pursued to the Seven Rivers Crossing and again utterly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Zhining and Tushan Kening he pursued to the Seven Rivers Crossing and again utterly defeated them.

sentences.zh: 元帥忠義遂留宗敘自從。

translations.literal: Marshal Zhongyi then kept Zongxu with him personally.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Zhongyi then kept Zongxu with him personally.

sentences.zh: 賊平，入為右宣徽使。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified he entered court as right palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified he entered court as right palace commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宋兵據海州，將謀深入。

translations.literal: Song troops held Haizhou and intended to advance deep inland.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops held Haizhou and intended to advance deep inland.

sentences.zh: 詔以宗敘為元帥右監軍，往禦之。

translations.literal: An edict made Zongxu right marshal supervisor to defend against them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Zongxu right marshal supervisor to defend against them.

sentences.zh: 宗敘駐山東，分兵據守要害，敵不得西。

translations.literal: Zongxu encamped in Shandong, divided troops to hold key points, and the enemy could not advance west.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxu encamped in Shandong, divided troops to hold key points, and the enemy could not advance west.

sentences.zh: 尋奉詔，與左副元帥紇石烈志甯參議軍事。

translations.literal: Soon by imperial order he joined left deputy marshal Heshilie Zhining in deliberating military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon by imperial order he joined left deputy marshal Heshilie Zhining in deliberating military affairs.

sentences.zh: 四年，宗敘入朝，奏曰：「暑月在近，頓兵邊陲，飛挽頗艱，乞俟秋涼進發。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zongxu entered court and memorialized: "The hot months are near; troops massed on the frontier make transport very difficult — I beg to wait until the autumn cool to advance."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Zongxu entered court and memorialized, "The hot months are near. Troops massed on the frontier make transport very difficult. I beg to wait until the autumn cool to advance."

sentences.zh: 上從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted his request.

sentences.zh: 及還軍，授以成算，賜襲衣、弓矢。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was given the completed plan and granted a suit of robes, bow, and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was given the completed plan and granted a suit of robes, bow, and arrows.

sentences.zh: 九月，渡淮，宗敘出唐、鄧，比至襄陽，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month they crossed the Huai. Zongxu went out through Tang and Deng; by the time he reached Xiangyang he had won repeated battles.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they crossed the Huai. Zongxu went out through Tang and Deng. By the time he reached Xiangyang he had won repeated battles.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋人請和，軍還，除河南路統軍使。

translations.literal: The next year the Song requested peace; the army returned and he was made commander-in-chief of the Henan Route.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Song requested peace. The army returned and he was made commander-in-chief of the Henan Route.

sentences.zh: 河決李固渡，分流曹、單之間。

translations.literal: The Yellow River broke through at Ligudu and divided its flow between Cao and Shan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through at Ligudu and divided its flow between Cao and Shan.

sentences.zh: 詔遣都水監梁肅視河決，宗敘言：「河道填淤不受水，故有決溢之患。

translations.literal: An edict sent Director of Waterworks Liang Su to inspect the breach. Zongxu said: "The river channel is silted and will not receive water, hence the danger of breach and overflow.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Director of Waterworks Liang Su to inspect the breach. Zongxu said, "The river channel is silted and will not receive water, hence the danger of breach and overflow.

sentences.zh: 今欲河複故道，卒難成功，幸而可塞，它日不免決溢山東，非曹、單比也。

translations.literal: Now if we wish the river to return to its old course, success will be hard to achieve at once. Even if it can be blocked, another day it will inevitably breach and overflow in Shandong — not comparable to Cao and Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Now if we wish the river to return to its old course, success will be hard to achieve at once. Even if it can be blocked, another day it will inevitably breach and overflow in Shandong — not comparable to Cao and Shan.

sentences.zh: 沿河數州，驟興大役，人心動搖，恐宋人乘間扇誘，構為邊患。」

translations.literal: Several prefectures along the river would suddenly undertake great works; hearts would be shaken, and I fear the Song would seize the interval to incite and seduce, creating border trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Several prefectures along the river would suddenly undertake great works. Hearts would be shaken, and I fear the Song would seize the interval to incite and seduce, creating border trouble."

sentences.zh: 梁肅亦請聽兩河分流，以殺水勢，遂止不塞。

translations.literal: Liang Su also requested allowing the two rivers to divide the flow to reduce the water's force; blocking was therefore halted.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Su also requested allowing the two rivers to divide the flow to reduce the water's force. Blocking was therefore halted.

sentences.zh: 十年，召至京師，拜參知政事，上曰：「卿奏黃河利害，甚合朕意。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was summoned to the capital and made participating councilor. The emperor said: "Your memorial on the Yellow River's advantages and harms fits my intent very well.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was summoned to the capital and made participating councilor. The emperor said, "Your memorial on the Yellow River's advantages and harms fits my intent very well.

sentences.zh: 朕念百姓差調，官吏為奸，率斂星火，所費倍蓰，委積經年，腐朽不可複用，若此等類，百孔千瘡，百姓何以堪之。

translations.literal: I think of the people's corvée and tax levies; officials act wickedly, collecting at the speed of a spark, with costs multiplied manyfold, piled up for years until rotten and unusable — matters of this kind are a hundred holes and a thousand sores; how can the people bear them?
translations.idiomatic: I think of the people's corvée and tax levies. Officials act wickedly, collecting at the speed of a spark, with costs multiplied manyfold, piled up for years until rotten and unusable. Matters of this kind are a hundred holes and a thousand sores. How can the people bear them?

sentences.zh: 卿參朝政，擇利而行，以副朕心。」

translations.literal: You participate in court government — choose what is beneficial and act, to fulfill my heart."
translations.idiomatic: You participate in court government — choose what is beneficial and act, to fulfill my heart."

sentences.zh: 及與上論南邊事，宗敘曰：「南人遣諜來，多得我事情。

translations.literal: When he discussed southern-border affairs with the emperor, Zongxu said: "The southerners send spies and learn much of our affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When he discussed southern-border affairs with the emperor, Zongxu said, "The southerners send spies and learn much of our affairs.

sentences.zh: 我遣諜人，多不得其實。

translations.literal: We send spies but often do not get the truth.
translations.idiomatic: We send spies but often do not get the truth.

sentences.zh: 蓋彼以厚賞故也。」

translations.literal: This is because they use rich rewards."
translations.idiomatic: This is because they use rich rewards."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「彼以厚利資諜人，徒費其財，何能為也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "They use rich profit to fund spies — they merely waste their wealth; what can they accomplish?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "They use rich profit to fund spies — they merely waste their wealth. What can they accomplish?"

sentences.zh: 十一年，奉詔巡邊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he received orders to tour the borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he received orders to tour the borders.

sentences.zh: 六月，至軍中，將戰，有疾，詔以右丞相紇石烈志甯代，宗敘還。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he reached the army and was about to fight when he fell ill; an edict had right chancellor Heshilie Zhining replace him and Zongxu returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he reached the army and was about to fight when he fell ill. An edict had right chancellor Heshilie Zhining replace him and Zongxu returned.

sentences.zh: 七月，病甚，遺表朝政得失，及邊防利害，力疾，使其子上之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month his illness grew severe; he left a final memorial on the gains and losses of court government and the advantages and harms of border defense, and though gravely ill had his son present it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month his illness grew severe. He left a final memorial on the gains and losses of court government and the advantages and harms of border defense, and though gravely ill had his son present it.

sentences.zh: 薨，年四十六。

translations.literal: He died at forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He died at forty-six.

sentences.zh: 上見其遺表，傷悼不已，輟朝，遣宣徽使敬嗣暉致祭，賻銀千兩、彩四十端、絹四百匹。

translations.literal: When the emperor saw his final memorial he grieved without end, suspended court, and sent palace commissioner Jing Sihui to perform the sacrifice, with funeral gifts of a thousand taels of silver, forty bolts of colored silk, and four hundred bolts of plain silk.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor saw his final memorial he grieved without end, suspended court, and sent palace commissioner Jing Sihui to perform the sacrifice, with funeral gifts of a thousand taels of silver, forty bolts of colored silk, and four hundred bolts of plain silk.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「宗敘勤勞國家，他人不能及也。」

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "Zongxu toiled for the state — others cannot compare with him."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "Zongxu toiled for the state — others cannot compare with him."

sentences.zh: 初，宗敘嘗請募貧民戍邊屯田，給以廩粟，既貧者無艱食之患，而富家免更代之勞，得專農業。

translations.literal: Earlier Zongxu had requested recruiting poor people to garrison the frontier and farm garrison fields, giving them granary grain; the poor would then have no hardship of scarce food, while rich families would be spared the labor of rotation and could devote themselves to agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zongxu had requested recruiting poor people to garrison the frontier and farm garrison fields, giving them granary grain. The poor would then have no hardship of scarce food, while rich families would be spared the labor of rotation and could devote themselves to agriculture.

sentences.zh: 上善其言，而未行也。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words but did not yet carry them out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words but did not yet carry them out.

sentences.zh: 十七年，上謂宰臣曰：「戍邊之卒，歲冒寒暑，往來番休，以馬牛往戍，往往皆死。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the emperor told the chief ministers: "Frontier garrison soldiers year by year brave heat and cold, coming and going in rotation; taking horses and cattle to the garrison, they often all die.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the emperor told the chief ministers, "Frontier garrison soldiers year by year brave heat and cold, coming and going in rotation. Taking horses and cattle to the garrison, they often all die.

sentences.zh: 且奪其農時，敗其生業，朕甚閔之。

translations.literal: Moreover it robs them of farming season and ruins their livelihood — I deeply pity them.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover it robs them of farming season and ruins their livelihood. I deeply pity them.

sentences.zh: 朕欲使百姓安于田裏，而邊圉強固，卿等何術可以致死。」

translations.literal: I wish the people to be secure in their fields while the border is strong and firm — what method can achieve this?"
translations.idiomatic: I wish the people to be secure in their fields while the border is strong and firm. What method can achieve this?"

sentences.zh: 左丞相良弼曰：「邊地不堪耕種，不能久戍，所以番代耳。」

translations.literal: Left Chancellor Liangbi said: "Frontier lands cannot bear cultivation and cannot be garrisoned long — that is why there is rotation."
translations.idiomatic: Left Chancellor Liangbi said, "Frontier lands cannot bear cultivation and cannot be garrisoned long — that is why there is rotation."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿等以此急務為未事耶。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Do you treat this urgent matter as something unimportant?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Do you treat this urgent matter as something unimportant?

sentences.zh: 往歲，參政宗敘嘗為朕言此事。

translations.literal: In former years the participating councilor Zongxu once spoke to me of this matter.
translations.idiomatic: In former years the participating councilor Zongxu once spoke to me of this matter.

sentences.zh: 若宗敘，可謂盡心于國者矣。

translations.literal: As for Zongxu, he may be called one who gave his whole heart to the state.
translations.idiomatic: As for Zongxu, he may be called one who gave his whole heart to the state.

sentences.zh: 今以兩路招討司、烏古裏石壘部族、臨潢、泰州等路，分置堡戍，詳定以聞，朕將親覽。」

translations.literal: Now for the two-route pacification commissions, the Wuguli Shilei tribal groups, and the routes of Linhuang, Taizhou, and others, establish fort garrisons in divisions, work out the details and report — I shall review them personally."
translations.idiomatic: Now for the two-route pacification commissions, the Wuguli Shilei tribal groups, and the routes of Linhuang, Taizhou, and others, establish fort garrisons in divisions, work out the details and report. I shall review them personally."

sentences.zh: 上追念宗敘，聞其子孫家用不給，詔賜錢三千貫。

translations.literal: The emperor recalled Zongxu with fondness; hearing his descendants' household expenses were insufficient, he ordered three thousand strings of cash granted.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年，配享世宗廟廷。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Mingchang he was given a place in the Shizong temple hall.
